offer.text: There's a bounty on those hissing green cowards — they cratered a client's home. Bring me 5 dead creepers.

accept.text: Watch the fuse and you'll be fine. Mostly. Go collect.

decline.text: Bounty stays unclaimed. Pity — it pays well.

in_progress.text: How's the bounty coming? Any booms?

ready.text: Five creepers culled and not a scratch on the client's new wall. Nicely handled.

complete.text: Bounty paid in full. You've got the makings of a fine mercenary.
